shorts.title: What you will learn: C vs C++: what changed
shorts.hook: C plus plus is C with superpowers.
shorts.script: C plus plus is C with superpowers. Today we compare C and C plus plus. You will see what stayed the same, and what is new. C plus plus grew out of the C language. Most C code still works in C plus plus. But C plus plus adds many features. It has classes, a bigger library, and safer ways to handle memory. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: What you will learn: C vs C++: what changed.

shorts.script: C plus plus grew out of the C language. Most C code still works in C plus plus. But C plus plus adds many features. It has classes, a bigger library, and safer ways to handle memory. Think of a bicycle and a motorbike. Both carry you to school. The motorbike has more parts, so you must learn more. Keep coding, says Xecxec!

shorts.title: Inside the second program
shorts.hook: Now the C plus plus way.
shorts.script: Now the C plus plus way. The cout tool takes the text with the insertion operator, which looks like two arrows. The endl word ends the line. The program returns zero, as before. Both styles give the same result on the screen. Both programs print one hello line. C plus plus lets you choose either style. C plus plus grew out of C. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Inside the second program.

shorts.title: Bug of the Day: Forgetting std
shorts.script: Bug of the Day. Here we write cout without std in front. The compiler says cout was not declared in this scope. It also suggests std colon colon cout. Library names live in the std namespace. Add the prefix, and the error goes away. Library names such as cout live in the std namespace. Write std colon colon in front, or use a using line, which we learn soon. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.onScreen: BUG OF THE DAY: FORGETTING STD
shorts.caption: Bug of the Day: Forgetting std.

shorts.title: Pun and challenge
shorts.hook: Why did C plus plus not invite C to the party? C said, I will be there, but only as a subset.
shorts.script: Why did C plus plus not invite C to the party? C said, I will be there, but only as a subset. Write one program that prints one line with printf and one line with cout. Write your answer in the comments. C plus plus grew out of C. Printf is the C way, and cout is the C plus plus way. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
